name: coordination/dispatch-reply-retry
description: The same `execution_key` again — a retry, not a replay. The committed dispatch receipt and its timestamp come back unchanged, `replayed` is true, and nothing is spent a second time. This is what lets a driver that lost its reply ask again safely, while a *different* execution key on the same receipt is refused (refusal-consent-spent).
